preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each array N is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**5 for A in As for i in range(len(A)))
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(A.count(x) <= 2 for A in As for x in set(A))
preconditions.description: Frequency of each integer in the array A is at most 2.

postconditions.description: There are exactly 2 lines of output for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[2*i]) == len(A) - sum(A[i] == B[i] for i in range(len(A))) for i, (A, B) in enumerate(zip(As, Bs)))
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case contains the maximum possible Hamming distance between A and B.

postconditions.expression: all(len(B) == len(A) for A, B in zip(As, Bs))
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case contains N space-separated integers denoting the array B.

postconditions.expression: all(B.count(x) <= 2 for B in Bs for x in set(B))
postconditions.description: Frequency of each integer in the array B is at most 2.

postconditions.expression: all(set(B) == set(A) for A, B in zip(As, Bs))
postconditions.description: Array B is obtained by shuffling the elements of array A.
